newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cargill Japan to sell feed plant to Chubu. [CORRECTED 09:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cargill Japan to sell feed plant to Chubu. [CORRECTED 09:40 GMT]

text.p: Cargill Japan Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to sell its 6,000-tonne-per-month (corrects capacity) feed plant in Kagoshima prefecture to Chubu Shiryo Co.
Cargill Japan did not reveal the cost of the transaction, although it expected the facility, as well as its 34 employees, to be transferred to Chubu by the end of March 1997.
The facility, which began operations in 1988, is Cargill's only feed production facility in Japan.
Cargill Japan is a fully owned subsidiary of U.S.-based Cargill Inc, the world's largest grain trading company.
